toml:
# Enhancement-technique what-ifs for one ILLUSTRATIVE ground site: a wavelength change, a larger
# receive aperture, an adaptive-optics scintillation reduction and extra margin, each predicted as
# an availability gain over the same site's baseline. The gains are stated inputs (Kshana does not
# model an adaptive-optics loop), a new wavelength or aperture re-evaluates the clear-sky budget,
# the clear-air loss and the aperture averaging, and everything is MODELLED. The terminal is
# deliberately margin-limited (about 3 dB before the atmosphere) so the techniques matter; the
# run also states the cloud ceiling that no technique lifts. Targets below 100 percent of the
# margin table are reported as the extra margin needed (negative means a surplus).
kind = "optical-atmosphere"
wavelength_nm = 1550.0
elevation_deg = 25.0
availability_targets_pct = [50.0, 60.0, 70.0]

[link]
tx_power_w = 0.5
tx_aperture_m = 0.1
rx_aperture_m = 0.3
range_km = 1000.0
optics_efficiency = 0.5
detector_efficiency = 0.7
pointing_loss_db = 3.0
receiver_sensitivity_dbm = -17.0

[atmosphere]
wave = "spherical"
direction = "uplink"
path_eff_km = 10.0
visibility_km = 15.0

[clock]
classes = ["tcxo", "ocxo", "dsac"]
threshold_ns = 100.0

[[site]]
name = "single-site"
lat_deg = 40.0
lon_deg = 12.0
altitude_m = 300.0
p_cloud = 0.2
median_lwp_kg_m2 = 0.03
sigma_ln = 1.0
mean_outage_h = 6.0
outage_sigma_ln = 1.0
data_source = "ILLUSTRATIVE input, not a measurement"

[[technique]]
name = "wavelength 1064 nm"
wavelength_nm = 1064.0

[[technique]]
name = "receive aperture 1.0 m"
rx_aperture_m = 1.0

[[technique]]
name = "adaptive optics, 80 % scintillation reduction"
scint_variance_reduction = 0.8

[[technique]]
name = "6 dB extra margin"
extra_margin_db = 6.0

[[technique]]
name = "aperture 1.0 m + AO + 3 dB"
rx_aperture_m = 1.0
scint_variance_reduction = 0.8
extra_margin_db = 3.0
summary: optical-atmosphere: 1550 nm at 25 deg elevation, margin 3.7 dB before the atmosphere; best site single-site 79.86 %; 1-site network 79.86 % independent / 79.86 % correlated weather (MODELLED, advisory)
